gates.description: At least one source file must be produced
No hardcoded passwords, tokens, or API keys
Error handling must be present in implementation
Tests must be produced alongside implementation
No console.log or debug statements in production code
Input validation must be present for API endpoints

anti_patterns.description: A single service class handling validation, business logic, data access, and notifications
Catching exceptions and returning a default value — errors become invisible
Request handler applying business rules, querying DB, sending emails, and formatting response
Global variables modified from multiple request handlers
Shipping without automated tests — no safety net for future changes

escalation_triggers: A database query cannot be optimized further and still doesn't meet latency SLA
A security vulnerability found in a dependency with no available patch
Business logic requires data from a service that doesn't expose it
Current architecture cannot support a new requirement without significant refactoring
Data inconsistency discovered in production with no clear root cause

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with API contracts and acceptance criteria

output_certifications: All API endpoints implemented per contract
Input validation present on all external inputs
Tests exist for all business logic
